verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that a Skyvern API key can be found, copied and rotated, and that organization limits can be set. Nothing documents issuing scoped, per-agent or least-privilege API credentials. Stored website-login credentials passed to the model as placeholders are a different capability (site authentication) and do not count as scoped API keys.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
